figurative_meaning_en: Immature or inexperienced adult/intellect; novice; frivolous young man
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এখনও চ্যাঙড়া, এত বড় দায়িত্ব নিতে পারবে না।
এই চ্যাঙড়া ছেলেরা শুধু ফচকে কথা বলে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is still a greenhorn and can't handle such a big responsibility.
These callow youths just talk frivolously.
note: The idiom draws from the image of an unripe jackfruit, symbolizing lack of maturity in Bengali rural culture.
